## Learning Outcome

In this chapter, we will learn the core concepts of `ggplot2` and practise using them to create statistical graphics based on the **Layered Grammar of Graphics**. By the end, we will be able to produce elegant and effective visualisations using `ggplot2`.

## Getting Started

### Installing and Loading the Required Libraries

Before getting started, let's install and load the required R packages into R environment. In this exercise, we need to install and load `tidyverse`.

| Package | Description |
|---------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| [tidyverse](https://www.tidyverse.org/) | A collection of R packages for data importing, cleaning, transformation, and visualisation (e.g., readr, dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2). |


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse)
```
:::
